summary: Scrambler injured in a boulder field on the south side of Boulder Creek near the Boulder Falls parking area; RMRG secured the patient in a vacuum splint and litter and evacuated them down steep rocky terrain to an ambulance.
location: Boulder Canyon, near Boulder Falls parking area
notes: Injury cause not specified; patient was scrambling, not rock climbing; RMRG's 47th call of 2016.
